rows.itemId: official-form-treatment:obligation:research-decision-route:AL:al-olr::official-form:Alabama AOC Order of Limited Relief packet
rows.sourceId: official-form:Alabama AOC Order of Limited Relief packet
rows.reason: STOPPED, narrowed by FABLE-D1 2026-09-01: no committed record establishes that an 'Alabama AOC Order of Limited Relief packet' exists as a document. What committed evidence DOES settle: the route's legal basis is a Petition for an Order of Limited Relief under Ala. Code § 12-26-1 et seq. (AL.memo.json track 'Order of Limited Relief from licensing bars'); the memo's open question AL-9 records that 'the governing output strategy and complete filing requirements ... remain unresolved' and that 'the absence of an official form alone would not block a custom pleading'; and a separate counsel question asks whether the OLR belongs in the catalogue at all, since it is a civil licensing-relief petition rather than a record-clearing route. The corroborated place an AOC form would be published if one exists is https://judicial.alabama.gov/library/criminal_forms (AL.memo.json + legal-design-track-registry.json). DISC cannot settle an identity for a packet no evidence names; the next owners are counsel (catalogue question) and, if kept, legal design (custom pleading vs form).
